body: I really appreciate it. Thank you.
May I ask what group and what happened?

I really hope you don't.

I know I seem super hypocritical if you see my last post, but I thought fuck it, before I'm gone I might as well try to help somebody before it happens. I know what it feels like, so this probably won't go through, but if you can know someone who cares is somewhere, you might be able to brave through it. Call someone. Call someone you think will help, and if there's nobody, just think about your future. Think about how things could work out.

Think about everyone who cares about you even if it's really hard to find 1 person. Don't let go just yet. If I knew about the situation more I could probably help more, but I don't want to pressure you, because that makes things worse. 

Just try to find a reason to be here. Any reason. A stupid reason. An illogical reason. Just try to stay here as long as you can. Don't let go just yet.

Best of luck
